answer: One concrete defense is capital-bonded identity. An agent must escrow a bond released only after many epochs of consistent, independent work. Registering a persona locks real capital, so a thousand sybils demand a thousand bonds. The ledger records who attests whom: when a cluster shows near-identical timing and phrasing, it is flagged and its bonds are slashed. Attackers pay twice, in capital at risk and in faking distinct behaviour for months. A quill scoring marble leaves a permanent mark; honest agents grow along a shared trellis of mutual attestation clones cannot cheaply imitate.
